summary: Iteration 6 (AI key/model config + readable Simple template + polished Advanced) verified end-to-end. Added new pytest module /app/backend/tests/test_ai_config_and_simple_text.py (6 tests) covering GET /api/ai/status shape, POST /api/ai/config invalid key (400), model switch + clear-to-default, simple-text preview ok/error, and advanced graph preset preview. Full backend suite: 48/48 passing (~93s). Frontend Playwright validated: Simple tab shows pre-filled simple-template textarea, all 5 preset chips (array/number/two/distinct/string) swap the template, simple-guide visible & collapsible, preview-btn renders valid input in preview-output; Advanced tab has advanced-template + 4 preset chips (array/matrix/graph/two) + advanced-guide, graph preset produced valid multi-line input '2 1\n1 2'. AI sheet 'Groq connection' expands, model-only save with llama-3.3-70b-versatile succeeded (toast 'AI connection saved'), obviously-invalid key 'gsk_definitely_bad_key_xyz' returned 400 and surfaced 'Couldn't save key — Invalid API key or could not reach Groq.' Reverted server to default model after tests. Regressions for all 6 verdicts (WA/AC-py/AC-java/CE/TLE/RTE/MLE), streaming, cancel, and AI endpoints (status/generate-solution[cpp,py,java]/generate-generator+preview/explain-off-by-one) all pass.

backend_new_tests.test_preview_simple_text_ok: PASS (n int, list of n ints in range, word len 4 a-z)

frontend_ui.ai_key_save_invalid: PASS (backend 400 + red toast 'Couldn't save key — Invalid API key...')

critical_code_review_comments: Nit: /api/ai/config persists overrides to .ai_config.json — good for hot-reload, but the file lives in the backend working dir and is not gitignored yet; if it is committed by accident it could leak a user key. Consider writing under a stable ignored path (e.g. /app/backend/.data/ai_config.json) and adding it to .gitignore.

Nit (UX): AIAssistant.ConnectionSection auto-collapses after a successful save, but the toast points users to a hidden state. Consider keeping it open on invalid-key errors so users can immediately correct the field (currently expanded state is preserved on error — verified — but a hint next to the field would help).

Nit: generate_simple_text friendly-error mentions 'in' for the missing keyword, which is helpful, but for the 'list' family it might also be worth suggesting the full form 'list <count> [distinct] ints in lo..hi' in the error string.
seed_data_creation: none; server state reset to default model after run
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend: /app/backend/tests/test_ai_config_and_simple_text.py covers the new /api/ai/status + /api/ai/config endpoints and the new simple-text generator. Server persists AI overrides in a JSON file — remember to POST {clear:true} in teardown if a test switches keys/model, to keep default model 'openai/gpt-oss-120b' stable for subsequent Groq tests. Frontend Simple/Advanced generator is now a plain <textarea> (not CodeMirror) with data-testid='simple-template' / 'advanced-template'; presets have data-testid='preset-<id>'; AI connection panel testids: ai-connection, ai-key-input, ai-model-select, ai-save-key-btn, ai-use-default-btn. To avoid burning Groq quota, prefer model-only save for the happy path.
